basics.name: Jakob Gabriel
basics.label: Digital Business Value Engineer
basics.summary: Digital transformation and advanced analytics expert with a record in scaling smart-factory solutions, optimizing manufacturing processes, and delivering measurable business value. Passionate about enabling innovation, driving agile projects, and empowering teams.

work.name: OESL Automotive (A portfolio company of Regent LP)
work.summary: Driving digital transformation and analytics strategy across global manufacturing sites during company carve-out, ensuring business continuity and scalability of established smart factory solutions.
highlights: Migrated and ensured continuity of 150+ digitalization use cases across 8+ global sites during company carve-out, achieving zero downtime in analytics services.
Maintained and evolved energy and process efficiency analytics workflows across global manufacturing sites, preserving €1M+ in annual savings.
Spearheading AI-driven process optimization initiatives to automate complex manufacturing decisions and reduce manual intervention.
Built organizational capabilities through targeted training programs, expanding the Smart Factory power-user network worldwide.
Redesigned key processes leveraging analytics insights to reduce lead times and increase operational efficiency across production lines.

work.name: Continental AG
work.summary: Driving digital transformation and analytics strategy across global manufacturing sites, with a focus on measurable value creation and scalability.
highlights: Scaled more than 150 digitalization use cases globally, achieving more than €1M in annual cost savings by applying data-driven optimization.
Developed energy and process efficiency analytics workflows that became reference models for data-driven manufacturing.
Championed more than 15 innovation initiatives annually, guiding proof-of-concepts until operational utilization
Built organizational capabilities through 20+ training programs, expanding the Smart Factory network worldwide.

work.name: Continental AG
work.summary: Designed and implemented analytics-driven solutions for manufacturing challenges while enabling global scalability across production sites.
highlights: Transformed raw production data into actionable insights, uncovering hidden inefficiencies and improving overall equipment effectiveness (OEE) across multiple lines.
Orchestrated cross-functional teams of 5+ members to develop predictive analytics models that prevented production bottlenecks and reduced scrap waste.
Defined global digitalization standards that unified data quality, analytics methodologies, and reporting across 8+ manufacturing plants.
Built intuitive Power BI dashboards used daily by 50+ operators and engineers for faster, evidence-based decision-making.
Created knowledge-sharing platforms and internal documentation that accelerated onboarding and scaled analytics adoption enterprise-wide.

work.name: Continental AG
work.summary: Ensured product quality during ramp up through risk management, process optimization, and customer-focused quality control and improvement initiatives.
highlights: Drove continuous improvement by systematically identifying and eliminating root causes of quality issues using 8D and Six Sigma methods, reducing defect rates during product ramp-up.
Collaborated with cross-functional teams to strengthen FMEA practices, transforming risk assessments into actionable process improvements across 3+ production lines.
Designed and implemented end-to-end inspection concepts for new products, enhancing product reliability and full traceability.
Built trusted customer relationships through transparent communication, on-site acceptance tests, and consistently successful audit results.
Introduced real-time quality dashboards visualizing key KPIs, improving shop-floor decision-making speed and reducing reaction time to quality events.
